message: `aria-relevant="removals"` on the `<div>` above it sets the live region of `warning` otherwise than its role does
$reason: A warning part two elements under a wrapper written `ARIA-RELEVANT="removals"`: HTML takes the name in any case, and Firefox 158 hands the part the nearest relevance up the tree, two elements up as one, as `container-relevant="removals"` beside the `status`'s `container-live="polite"` (measured on 2026-10-27); NVDA then drops the warning's events. Chromium 153 exposes none of it on the part. A reading of the parent alone, or of the name as written, passed it. Point 7 read nothing above the part but what may hide it, and passed it.
